messages:
maria: Quick sync — I reviewed the postmortem notes and want to lock owners/timelines for the token validation incident. Found 3 open items we need to close this sprint.

aj: Ack. Can you list the items here so we can assign?

maria: 1) Fix flaky token TTL parsing in validator service. 2) Add deterministic test for validation edge cases. 3) Ensure audit logs include raw token_id for failed validations (redacted where needed).

sam: I can take #1 (validator parsing). ETA end of week? I need a short pairing session with @kai to make sure we don't regress batching.
kai: SGTM. Sam + me Thurs 10am for pairing.

maria: @sam please add a PR link and set milestone. Also we should add a rollback plan for any perf regressions — if latency > 50ms P95 we revert.

sam: Will do. Quick note: current test harness doesn't cover `exp` missing case. That caused the drift. Will add a unit + integration test.

aj: I'll own #2 (tests + CI gate). I can add a new job that runs the edge-case suite on every PR. ETA Tue.

kai: For #3 (audit logs) — we should avoid storing full token material. Proposal: store hashed token_id + reason + validator_version. We can append a flag for redaction.
maria: That sounds good. Can we also add a one-off migration to backfill recent failures so SRE can triage recurring patterns?
kai: Yes. I'll write a migration script that aggregates last 30d failed validations and writes hashed ids to the logs index.

sam: PR: <https://github.com/redwood/validator/pull/842> — draft for parsing fix. Tests still pending.
maria: Nice. @aj once your CI gate is in place we can mark tests required.

aj: CI job created: `token-edge-cases` in Circle. Linking: <https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/3201>. Marked required for protected branches.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment queued for canary: validator-service v2.14.3-canary (by sam).

sam: Canary in canary cluster looks ok — no CPU spike, latency stable. Will run extended traffic until EOD.

maria: Good. Two more follow-ups: A) secrets rotation cadence — rotate signing key every 30 days and on owner change. B) Owners: validator service -> sam, audit pipeline -> kai, tests/CI -> aj.

kai: For secret rotation, can we add a preflight check that validates old/new keys overlap window? I can add it to the migration plan.

maria: Also noticed a repeating pattern across incidents: token TTL drift + stale key cached in some regions. Can the infra team add a periodic KV eviction and a metric alert when TTL mismatch > 10%?
aj: I'll add the alert in OpsPlaybook: `token_ttl_drift_ratio > 0.10` -> pager to infra on-call.

sam: Setting milestone: `sprint-34` for code + tests, `ops-rotation` for secrets/workflow, and `audit-backfill` for migration.

maria: Owners + deadlines recap: sam -> parser fix PR by Thu (3276620000), aj -> CI gate + tests by Tue (3276580000), kai -> audit migration + rotation preflight by next Wed (3276690000). If anyone needs to shift, ping here.
kai: noted. I'll add a checklist in the postmortem doc and assign Jira tasks.
sam: Added Jira: RD-1182 (parser fix), RD-1183 (integration tests).
aj: Added RD-1184 (CI job) and RD-1185 (alert).

maria: Thanks. One more ask — can someone run a quick audit to surface any service accounts that still have long-lived tokens? We should rotate those ASAP.
kai: I'll run a query against `auth.events` to list `service_account` failed_auth events with `token_age > 30d`. Command: ```sql
SELECT service_account, count(*) as failures, max(token_age) as max_age
FROM auth.events
WHERE event_type = 'failed_validation'
  AND token_age > 30*24*3600
GROUP BY service_account
ORDER BY max_age DESC;
```
I'll post results when done.

sam: Thanks. Quick reminder: label all PRs with `security-high` so we get faster reviews.
maria: Agree. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: audit-bot: Migration job scheduled: `audit-backfill-327654` — runs 2025-11-05T02:00Z.

kai: Posted results for the service_account query — 3 accounts flagged, reaching out to owners.

maria: Closing note — we'll run a short follow-up in next incident retro to confirm closure. If all tasks done before the retro, we'll mark postmortem resolved. Thanks all.
sam: Thanks everyone.
aj: Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
